one_line_pitch: On-demand food delivery for university campuses, powered by student couriers.
problem_statement: Students at large universities struggle to find fast, affordable meal options outside cafeteria hours. Existing delivery apps charge high fees and have slow campus delivery times due to unfamiliarity with campus layouts.
proposed_solution: A mobile app exclusively for campus food delivery. Student couriers who know the campus get paid per delivery. Restaurants partner with us for campus-exclusive menus at lower margins.
target_market: US university students aged 18-24. Focus on campuses with 10,000+ students. Estimated 300 target campuses.
business_model: Commission per order (15%) plus monthly restaurant partner fee ($99/month). No subscription for students.
traction_summary: Pilot at University of Michigan: 200 orders in first month, 3 restaurant partners, 12 student couriers.
competitive_landscape: DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub all operate on campuses but treat them as standard delivery zones. No campus-native competitor identified.
technical_status: React Native app (iOS and Android) in beta. Backend on Firebase. Working payment integration via Stripe.
